shapes.name: nested_and_or
shapes.notes: eval mode covers nested and/or value preservation.

shapes.name: mixed_short_circuit_return
shapes.notes: exec-mode nested closure covers false values, result fallback, type, and lazy addition.

shapes.name: short_circuit_evaluation_order
shapes.notes: Observable call order is compared between original and recovered expressions.

shapes.name: conditional_expression
shapes.notes: Recovered AST must contain ast.IfExp.

shapes.name: chained_comparison
shapes.notes: Covers chained comparison filters for all comprehension forms.

shapes.name: explicit_if_multiple_return
shapes.notes: Explicit if statements with multiple return sites remain statement control flow.

shapes.name: if_elif_else
shapes.notes: Behavior coverage includes classify, nested conditions, and choose.

shapes.name: for_break_continue_else
shapes.notes: Behavior coverage includes for loops, nested loops, break, continue, and loop else.

shapes.name: while_break_continue_else
shapes.notes: Behavior coverage includes while, None predicates, and continue.

shapes.name: irreducible_control_flow
shapes.notes: Artificial irreducible graphs are rejected instead of guessed.

shapes.name: nested_comprehension_filter
shapes.notes: Covers nested comprehensions, filters, lambdas, and scope isolation.

shapes.name: generator_and_yield_from
shapes.notes: Covers generator yield, yield from, send, and return behavior.

shapes.name: coroutine_await
shapes.notes: Coroutine and await behavior is compared through asyncio.

shapes.name: async_for
shapes.notes: Async iteration protocol and loop behavior are covered.

shapes.name: try_except_else_finally
shapes.notes: Covers normal, handled, else, finally, and reraised paths.

shapes.name: with_statement
shapes.notes: Context-manager enter, exit, suppression, and propagation are compared.

shapes.name: async_with
shapes.notes: Async context-manager behavior is compared.

shapes.name: except_star_basic
shapes.notes: Covers ExceptionGroup splitting, handling, and reraising.

shapes.name: except_star_with_else
shapes.notes: The current parser rejects except* combined with an else suite.

shapes.name: except_star_with_finally
shapes.notes: The current parser rejects except* combined with an enclosing finally.

shapes.name: match_patterns_and_guards
shapes.notes: Covers canonical mapping, sequence, class, OR, AS, star, and guard forms.

shapes.name: single_mode_print_expr
shapes.notes: compile(..., mode='single') exercises PRINT_EXPR outside the file corpus.

shapes.name: extended_arg
shapes.notes: Large generated functions cover EXTENDED_ARG and deep constants.

shapes.name: closure_class_scope
shapes.notes: General closure and class coverage exists, but LOAD_CLASSDEREF needs an attributed fixture.

shapes.name: variable_annotations
shapes.notes: SETUP_ANNOTATIONS is not present in the current file corpus.

shapes.name: assert_statement
shapes.notes: LOAD_ASSERTION_ERROR is not present in the current file corpus.

shapes.name: import_star
shapes.notes: IMPORT_STAR is not present in the current file corpus.

shapes.name: starred_collection_build
shapes.notes: LIST_TO_TUPLE and SET_UPDATE require attributed fixtures.

shapes.name: incremental_mapping_build
shapes.notes: Uncommon incrementally built mapping layouts remain a documented limitation.

shapes.name: scope_deletion
shapes.notes: DELETE_ATTR, DELETE_DEREF, and DELETE_GLOBAL need attributed fixtures.
